attr.title: betterPod
attr.desc: iPod-style music player: split-screen menus, Cover Flow, 3D Now Playing, search and games. Plays your own music, including lossless and hi-res. Interface based on iPod.js by Tanner Villarete; player engine from MiyooPod.
attr.inst: Put your music (FLAC, ALAC, AAC, WAV, AIFF, MP3, OGG) in /userdata/music.
